rows.label: LECTURE
rows.clue: A speech that is open to the public

rows.label: SONATA
rows.clue: A musical composition of 3 or 4 movements of contrasting forms

rows.label: OPUS
rows.clue: A musical work that has been created

rows.label: RETORT
rows.clue: A quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)

rows.label: SICK LIST
rows.clue: A list of those who are ill (e.g. on a warship or in a regiment etc)

rows.label: SCRIPT
rows.clue: A written version of a play or other dramatic composition

rows.label: PINK SLIP
rows.clue: Official notice that you have been fired from your job

rows.label: SECTION
rows.clue: A self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)

rows.label: AUDIO
rows.clue: The audible part of a transmitted signal

rows.label: SIGNING
rows.clue: Language expressed by visible hand gestures

rows.label: PASSWORD
rows.clue: A secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group

rows.label: LYRIC
rows.clue: The text of a popular song or musical-comedy number

rows.label: MOTION
rows.clue: The use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals

rows.label: FOLDER
rows.clue: A small book usually having a paper cover

rows.label: SAYING
rows.clue: A word or phrase that particular people use in particular situations

rows.label: MEMOIR
rows.clue: An account of the author's personal experiences

rows.label: PUN
rows.clue: A humorous play on words

rows.label: THANKS
rows.clue: An acknowledgment of appreciation

rows.label: HEAD WORD
rows.clue: A content word that can be qualified by a modifier

rows.label: SNOW JOB
rows.clue: A long and elaborate misrepresentation

rows.label: HYMNAL
rows.clue: A songbook containing a collection of hymns

rows.label: BAR LINE
rows.clue: A vertical line before the accented beat marking the boundary between musical bars

rows.label: THEOREM
rows.clue: A proposition deducible from basic postulates

rows.label: PASSPORT
rows.clue: Any authorization to pass or go somewhere

rows.label: ALTO CLEF
rows.clue: A clef that puts middle C on the third line of a staff

rows.label: HYPHEN
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text

rows.label: SYLLABLE
rows.clue: A unit of spoken language larger than a phoneme

rows.label: CITE
rows.clue: A short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage

rows.label: BLUE LAW
rows.clue: A statute regulating work on Sundays

rows.label: LAST NAME
rows.clue: The name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)

rows.label: CHORTLE
rows.clue: A soft partly suppressed laugh

rows.label: CLEF
rows.clue: A musical notation written on a staff indicating the pitch of the notes following it

rows.label: DROOL
rows.clue: Pretentious or silly talk or writing

rows.label: STATUTE
rows.clue: An act passed by a legislative body

rows.label: TAX BILL
rows.clue: Money owed for taxes

rows.label: CORE DUMP
rows.clue: (computer science) dump of the contents of the chief registers in the CPU

rows.label: YEARLY
rows.clue: A reference book that is published regularly once every year

rows.label: IDIOM
rows.clue: A manner of speaking that is natural to native speakers of a language

rows.label: ITEM
rows.clue: A distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list

rows.label: SKINNY
rows.clue: Confidential information about a topic or person

rows.label: ARTICLE
rows.clue: Nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication

rows.label: SMIRK
rows.clue: A smile expressing smugness or scorn instead of pleasure

rows.label: STEER
rows.clue: An indication of potential opportunity

rows.label: CLAUSE
rows.clue: (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence

rows.label: PERMIT
rows.clue: A legal document giving official permission to do something

rows.label: MUMBLING
rows.clue: Indistinct enunciation

rows.label: POSITIVE
rows.clue: The primary form of an adjective or adverb

rows.label: GLOSSARY
rows.clue: An alphabetical list of technical terms in some specialized field of knowledge

rows.label: VIDEO
rows.clue: The visible part of a television transmission

rows.label: HARD COPY
rows.clue: (computer science) matter that is held in a computer and is typed or printed on paper

rows.label: WHOPPER
rows.clue: A gross untruth

rows.label: ACCOUNT
rows.clue: A record or narrative description of past events

rows.label: SOFT NEWS
rows.clue: News that does not deal with serious topics or events

rows.label: NOVEL
rows.clue: An extended fictional work in prose

rows.label: DISPATCH
rows.clue: An official report (usually sent in haste)

rows.label: PET PEEVE
rows.clue: An opportunity for complaint that is seldom missed

rows.label: NAME TAG
rows.clue: A tag showing the name of the person who wears it

rows.label: YOWL
rows.clue: A very loud utterance (like the sound of an animal)

rows.label: THESIS
rows.clue: An unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument

rows.label: BADGE
rows.clue: An emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)

rows.label: MAIN FILE
rows.clue: (computer science) a computer file that is used as the authority in a given job and that is relatively permanent

rows.label: YELLING
rows.clue: Uttering a loud inarticulate cry as of pain or excitement

rows.label: TEXT
rows.clue: The words of something written

rows.label: BEACON
rows.clue: A fire (usually on a hill or tower) that can be seen from a distance

rows.label: MEMO
rows.clue: A written proposal or reminder

rows.label: FEIGNING
rows.clue: Pretending with intention to deceive

rows.label: SCENARIO
rows.clue: An outline or synopsis of a play (or, by extension, of a literary work)

rows.label: JUNK MAIL
rows.clue: Third-class mail consisting of advertising and often addressed to `resident' or `occupant'

rows.label: TOLL CALL
rows.clue: A long-distance telephone call at charges above a local rate

rows.label: LIBEL
rows.clue: A false and malicious publication printed for the purpose of defaming a living person

rows.label: WORD
rows.clue: A unit of language that native speakers can identify

rows.label: MEDIUM
rows.clue: A means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information

rows.label: FILING
rows.clue: The entering of a legal document into the public record

rows.label: CUE
rows.clue: An actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech

rows.label: BASS PART
rows.clue: The lowest part in polyphonic music

rows.label: SLOT
rows.clue: A position in a grammatical linguistic construction in which a variety of alternative units are interchangeable

rows.label: LAMBDA
rows.clue: The 11th letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: SERIAL
rows.clue: A serialized set of programs

rows.label: LINE ITEM
rows.clue: An item in an appropriation bill

rows.label: MANUAL
rows.clue: A small handbook

rows.label: FORECAST
rows.clue: A prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop

rows.label: SHAFT
rows.clue: A line that forms the length of an arrow pointer

rows.label: SHRUG
rows.clue: A gesture involving the shoulders

rows.label: ADVICE
rows.clue: A proposal for an appropriate course of action

rows.label: RECIPE
rows.clue: Directions for making something

rows.label: COMMA
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (,) used to indicate the separation of elements within the grammatical structure of a sentence

rows.label: SIGNAL
rows.clue: Any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message

rows.label: SYNOPSIS
rows.clue: A sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory

rows.label: POST CARD
rows.clue: A card for sending messages by post without an envelope

rows.label: STAVE
rows.clue: (music) the system of five horizontal lines on which the musical notes are written

rows.label: SIGMA
rows.clue: The 18th letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: DIGEST
rows.clue: A periodical that summarizes the news

rows.label: NOMINAL
rows.clue: A phrase that can function as the subject or object of a verb

rows.label: PHRASE
rows.clue: An expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence

rows.label: RUNDOWN
rows.clue: A concluding summary (as in presenting a case before a law court)

rows.label: ENTRY
rows.clue: An item inserted in a written record
